packDescription: A rugged military laser rifle in chipped olive paint. Instead of bullets it fires a focused beam of light that arrives the instant you pull the trigger: no drop, no lead, no travel time. Each shot hits for 350 and has a chance to set its target on fire. Runs on a Laser Battery of 50 shots; recharge batteries with Laser Charges. Fires about 400 shots a minute with almost no recoil, and makes a sharp electric crack you will learn to love.
author: girthy_mods
